messages:
talia: Morning — day 3 check-in. Quick status: I got my laptop image, installed dev container, and ran the intro tests. ran into a couple infra hiccups below.

What I did yesterday:
- finished quickstart app walkthrough and accepted all policies.
- spun up dev container (docker-compose) and validated unit tests.
- tried to provision a GPU instance to run the sample inference job.

Blockers:
- VPN split-tunnel seems to drop some requests; `gcloud auth login` times out behind VPN.
- GPU request tickets show quota error (looks like project-level GPU quota not granted).
- Docker registry login fails with 403 when pulling `registry.redwood.io/redwood/sample-model:latest` — says "insufficient scope".

Today:
- unblock VPN or get a workaround for auth so I can continue model tests.
- follow up on GPU quota and registry access.
- start the onboarding eval prompt set if infra is ready.

sam: Hey @talia — for the VPN timeout, can you try disabling split-tunnel in the client and re-run `gcloud auth login`? Some corporate endpoints get routed odd. Also paste the exact `gcloud` error if it persists.

it-ops: @talia I see a GPU quota request open for your email. Approved for 1x A10G for 48h to run onboarding. Provisioning in progress.

talia: thanks! running `gcloud auth login` now after toggling split-tunnel — still hangs, output: `ERROR: There was a problem with the network connection; check your proxy/VPN settings.`

devex: @talia for the registry 403 we usually need an SSO token from the console. Try `docker login registry.redwood.io` and use the token from https://console.redwood.io/_token (requires SSO). If that doesn't work, we'll add you to the registry group.

infra-bot: [provisioning] GPU instance queued: a10g-1 for project redwood-dev-42. ETA ~6m.

teju: pinged security to temporarily allow the auth callback domain through the VPN. Also sent a registry group invite to your email.

talia: quick follow-ups — I accepted the registry invite and retried `docker pull` and now it progresses further but fails at layer 12/18 with `403 Forbidden`. Full snippet: `pull access denied for registry.redwood.io/redwood/sample-model, repository does not exist or may require 'docker login'`.

sam: hmm — can you run `curl -v https://registry.redwood.io/v2/` from your laptop and paste response? Might be an edge auth header missing.

talia: curl gives 401 with header `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm=\"https://auth.redwood.io/\",service=\"registry.redwood.io\"` — seems like token exchange failing behind VPN.

it-ops: @talia I'm going to create a temporary SSH jump in the corp network so you can test without split-tunnel. Will post details in DM.

devex: If you need to run small inference without GPU we can run a quantized CPU container in the shared dev pool while you wait for GPU. `docker run --rm registry.redwood.io/redwood/sample-model:cpu-quant` should work if you have registry access.

talia: appreciate it. I'll try the jump and the cpu-quant image. Planning to run the eval harness this afternoon. Will update here once I can pull the full model.

teju: status note — security allowed the auth callback domain through VPN for your IP for 2 hours. If you still see auth errors after that window, ping me and we'll extend.

talia: Great, that did it — `gcloud auth login` succeeded after disabling split-tunnel for the callback and using the SSH jump for registry pull. GPU instance is up and I can `ssh` in. No more blockers for onboarding tasks. Thanks all! :party_parrot:

sam: awesome — welcome aboard! If you want, I can pair for the eval harness later today.

talia: would love that. scheduling a 2pm PT pairing session.

infra-bot: [completed] GPU instance a10g-1 provisioned and attached to redwood-dev-42.

teju: marked onboarding ticket as progressed. Good to go!
